dish.title: Southern Chicken and Dumplings with Carrots, Celery, and Thyme
dish.description: Chicken thighs simmered in chicken broth with onion, carrots, celery, thyme, and bay, thickened with a butter and flour roux, then topped with fluffy drop dumplings of flour, baking powder, milk, butter, and parsley steamed under the lid.

recipe_version.title: Southern Chicken and Dumplings with Carrots, Celery, and Thyme
recipe_version.description: Chicken thighs simmered in chicken broth with onion, carrots, celery, thyme, and bay, thickened with a butter and flour roux, then topped with fluffy drop dumplings of flour, baking powder, milk, butter, and parsley steamed under the lid.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.note: 3 tbsp stew, 3 tbsp melted for the dumplings

ingredients.name: chicken broth
ingredients.display_name: low-sodium chicken broth whose label lists chicken stock, salt, and vegetable flavorings

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces. Dice the onion and slice the carrots and celery. Melt 3 tbsp butter for the dumplings and chop the parsley.

steps.title: Roux and vegetables
steps.body: Melt 3 tbsp butter in the 6-quart Dutch oven over medium. Cook the onion, carrots, and celery until the onion softens, about 6 minutes. Stir in 1/4 cup flour and cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the stew
steps.body: Whisk in the broth gradually, then add the chicken, thyme, bay leaf, 1 1/2 tsp salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil over medium-high, about 10 minutes to come to a boil, then simmer gently until the chicken reaches 175 F and the stew thickens, about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Mix the dumplings
steps.body: Stir 1 1/2 cups flour, the baking powder, and 1/2 tsp salt in the medium bowl. Stir in the milk, melted butter, and parsley just until a sticky dough forms.

steps.title: Steam the dumplings
steps.body: Discard the bay leaf. With 2 large spoons, drop 12 mounds of dough over the simmering stew. Cover and simmer on low without lifting the lid until puffed and 200 F inside, about 15 minutes. Serve in bowls.

coverage_contribution: American comfort food in the catalog has pot pie, chili, and gumbo but no chicken and dumplings. A homestyle poultry stew.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with herb-vegetable-pot-pie: a chicken stew under steamed drop dumplings, not a vegetable filling under baked pastry. Compared with chicken-andouille-gumbo: a mild thyme cream-colored stew, not a dark roux gumbo with sausage over rice. Compared with colombian-ajiaco: a thick stew with dumplings, not a potato and corn soup.
not_duplicate_of: Not chicken pot pie (no crust) and not chicken noodle soup (no noodles). Unlike greek-avgolemono-chicken-soup in this wave, it is a roux-thickened stew with dumplings, not an egg-lemon rice soup.
